name: Paul Oakenfold
description:
Legendary Paul Oakenfold will perform at VULKAN ARENA, OSLO, on December 5th.

Paul Oakenfold is one of the most influential and iconic figures in electronic music. A true pioneer of the global dance scene, the legendary British DJ and producer has played a defining role in shaping club culture for more than three decades.

From legendary clubs and festivals to stages around the world, Oakenfold is known for his genre-spanning sets, combining trance, progressive house and driving electronic sounds. With an extraordinary career, countless acclaimed releases and performances in front of audiences across the globe, he remains a true icon of electronic music.

Expect a powerful and unforgettable night at VULKAN ARENA with one of the most legendary names in dance music history.
